name: citadel-dusk-v01
prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: production scenic background for an original tactical fantasy game; landscape 16:9 image.
Primary request: Create a NEW separate reusable environment painting of a ruined rune-lit citadel courtyard at dusk. This is scene art alone, NOT a screenshot or game UI. Mature detailed anime dark-fantasy environmental painting with believable architecture and crisp tactile stone.
Scene/backdrop: a high abandoned stone terrace surrounded by ruined pillars and fractured walls, ivy and sparse moss, dark blue cloth hanging at side ruins, small warm braziers on perimeter, distant Gothic fantasy citadel spires and a bridge silhouetted under a peach-gold dusk horizon and blue-grey mountains. Restrained cyan engraved magical marks on a few upright stones near the sides.
Composition/framing: wide 16:9, elevated shallow downward view toward the distant horizon. Central 60 percent is a quiet unobstructed flat expanse of weathered stone, lower-middle space clear for a separate tactical board. Most rich architecture lives at left and right perimeter; distant skyline in upper quarter. Foreground masonry anchors lower corners. No focal object center.
Lighting/mood: cool ink-blue dusk shadows with warm amber practical lights and soft gold horizon. Dark enough to frame game panels, preserve stone detail.
Constraints: original coherent architectural construction; fully clean background only; NO tactical tiles, grid, checkerboard, characters, creature, weapons, portraits, labels, HUD, controls, text, letters, numbers, logos, signatures, watermarks, borders or interface. Magical marks are abstract ornamental strokes, never readable writing.

name: enchanted-arena-v01
prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: production scenic alternate battle environment, wide landscape 16:9.
Primary request: Original enchanted stone arena in a ruined woodland sanctuary at blue dusk. Mature premium anime dark fantasy environment painting; tactile weathered stone, restrained magic.
Scene/backdrop: wide abandoned courtyard inside a broken circular colonnade, overgrown outer walls and dark ancient forest beyond. A few upright runestones on the far left and far right have subtle teal luminous abstract engraved motifs. Amber lanterns glow at low perimeter stone pedestals. Slight mist in the distant forest, muted violet dusk sky. Central floor is plain worn pale grey stone with fine seams and fine cracks, modest moss at edges.
Composition/framing: elevated shallow downward view, wide 16:9. Broad quiet central open floor reserved for separately-rendered tactical board, no central object or structures. Perimeter columns and forest frame sides, distant architecture upper quarter. Believable arena construction, depth, crisp readable edges.
Lighting/mood: blue teal dusk, muted jade vegetation, amber lanterns, restrained violet in sky. Preserve medium-dark midtones and material definition.
Constraints: clean environment art only. No characters, creatures, figures, statues shaped like people, tactical grid, square game tiles, painted game board, text, runic lettering, UI, HUD, controls, portraits, icons, logos, watermarks, frames. Original setting, no franchise designs.

name: terrain-open-stone-v01
prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: seamless square top-down game terrain surface texture, production tile material.
Primary request: Crisp hand-painted mature anime fantasy weathered stone pavement seen from perfectly vertical orthographic overhead. Edge-to-edge surface fills a 1:1 square image. Muted warm-grey limestone slabs, believable fine pitting and hairline cracks, soft dark seams with subtle dust. Several irregular interlocking broad stones at varied angles, no distinct decorative focal object.
Composition: completely flat overhead material texture, no perspective, no horizon, no raised objects. Even detail density; broad readable stone shapes at 48px. Soft light from upper left without cast shadows from objects. Gentle moss crumbs only in a few joints, less than 3 percent green.
Palette: light-medium warm grey stone, charcoal seams, subdued gold-grey highlights. Match a dusk ruined citadel.
Constraints: tileable surface on all four edges, continuous material, no border, no bevel framing the image, no tile outline, no regular square game grid, no checkerboard, text, runes, symbols, UI, people, creatures, plants projecting upwards, water, glow, logos or watermark.

name: terrain-rough-moss-v01
prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: seamless square top-down rough terrain surface texture for existing difficult terrain rules.
Primary request: Crisp hand-painted mature anime fantasy uneven broken stone pavement with rough angular rubble, moss and short grass in joints, viewed from perfectly vertical orthographic overhead. Edge-to-edge surface fills a 1:1 square. Weathered grey stones of varied size, a few small loose sharp stones, clear patchy moss clumps occupying about 25 percent surface. Distinguish from smooth stone by jagged fractured shapes and moss, while keeping subdued contrast under tactical tokens.
Composition: flat overhead material swatch, no horizon or camera perspective, no tall obstacle. Even density, larger moss patches readable at 48px. Seamless edges. Quiet subdued upper-left lighting.
Palette: neutral cool grey stone and olive/jade moss; darker seams. Same premium painted rendering as ruined dusk citadel.
Constraints: no raised wall, pillar, cover object, solid blocker, pond, water, snow, frost, magical hazard, text, runes, symbols, UI, grid, regular checkerboard, border, frame, logo or watermark. This is traversable rough ground material only.

name: terrain-raised-stone-v01
prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: square orthographic top-down raised stone floor terrain material; existing elevation presentation only.
Primary request: Crisp hand-painted mature anime fantasy cut stone platform floor from perfectly vertical overhead. A large solid weathered ash-grey stone landing, broad heavy flagstones, finely chipped stone and old subdued geometric carving scars. Edge-to-edge square material with clear broad horizontal stone courses and solid pale-grey planar facets; tactile heavier cut stone than ordinary courtyard pavement.
Composition/framing: overhead 1:1 full frame floor material only, no horizon, no isometric cube, no perspective. Even muted upper-left light. Readable broad shape at 48px. Small moss in fine cracks below 5 percent surface. Raised quality comes from heavy dressed masonry, NOT a tall pillar or blocked tile; gameplay will add the edge/elevation marker.
Palette: medium grey with warm limestone highlights and dark thin seams matching ruined dusk citadel.
Constraints: no free-standing rock, cover obstacle, high wall, pillar, character, water, text, numbers, runes, icons, UI, grid, regular checkerboard, painted outline, framing border, logo or watermark. Tileable edges, all-surface texture.
